newsHighlights.title: AI for good needs US-China cooperation
newsHighlights.summary: A Turing Award winner states President Xi's US visit is a perfect chance to launch global AI cooperation between China and the US.
newsHighlights.translation: 图灵奖得主表示，习近平主席的美国之行是启动中美全球AI合作的绝佳时机。

newsHighlights.title: China's new calling cards: AI, robots and new drugs
newsHighlights.summary: China's new 'new three' industries—AI, robotics, and innovative drugs—are reshaping its global image through exporting technology.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国新的“三样”——人工智能、机器人和创新药物——正通过出口技术重塑其全球形象。

newsHighlights.title: Xi to pay state visit to US from Sept 23 to 25
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to the United States next week at the invitation of President Trump.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席应特朗普总统邀请将于下周对美国进行国事访问。

newsHighlights.title: China to further prioritize AI-driven manufacturing
newsHighlights.summary: China is set to further prioritize the development of AI-driven manufacturing to enhance its industrial capabilities.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国将进一步优先发展人工智能驱动的制造业，以提升其产业能力。

newsHighlights.title: Paving a win-win path for China and the West
newsHighlights.summary: This article discusses how fostering cooperation can create mutual benefits and a positive future for global development.
newsHighlights.translation: 本文探讨了如何通过促进合作，为全球发展创造互惠互利和积极的未来。

quote.quote: Education is not preparation for life; education is life itself.
quote.author: John Dewey
quote.translation: 教育不是为生活做准备，教育就是生活本身。
quote.explanation: 这句名言提醒我们，学习（如理解今日新闻中的科技与合作）并非遥远未来的准备，而是塑造我们当下认知、参与世界并实现个人成长的持续过程。

pattern.pattern: 主语 + serves as a perfect opportunity for + (动名词/名词短语)
pattern.example: The upcoming US visit by President Xi Jinping serves as a perfect opportunity for launching global AI cooperation.
pattern.translation: 习近平主席即将进行的美国之行，为启动全球人工智能合作提供了绝佳机会。
pattern.usage: 用于表达某个事件或时机是做某事的完美契机，是一个非常地道且正式的表达。在新闻、演讲或正式写作中常见。

grammar.title: 动名词作宾语 (Gerund as Object)
grammar.explanation: 当动词后面接另一个动词来表示动作时，如果第二个动词作为介词宾语或某些动词的宾语，需要使用其动名词形式（-ing形式）。例如，在短语'need cooperation'中，cooperation是名词；但表达'需要做某事'时，如'need cooperation'（需要合作）与'need doing'（需要被做）结构不同。更典型的例子是新闻标题'AI for good needs US-China cooperation'，虽然这里cooperation是名词，但我们可以扩展到类似结构如'The project needs optimizing'（这个项目需要被优化）。
examples: AI for good needs US-China cooperation. (cooperation是名词宾语)
This technology requires further developing. (developing是动名词宾语)

pronunciation.tips: 注意重音在第三个音节'ra'上 (/ˈreɪ/)。'oo' 发 /oʊ/ 音，类似 'go' 中的元音。整个单词可以分为四个音节：co-op-er-a-tion。
examples: International cooperation is vital for climate change.
Their cooperation led to a breakthrough in AI research.

reading.title: Tech Cooperation and the Path to Growth
reading.content: The world is witnessing rapid advancements in artificial intelligence, robotics, and innovative medicine. China, in particular, is making significant strides with its 'new three' industries, exporting not just products, but also patents and algorithms. This evolution is reshaping its global image. As Turing Award winner Joseph Sifakis noted, an upcoming state visit by President Xi to the US serves as a perfect opportunity to launch global AI cooperation for the greater good. True progress, however, depends on more than just technological breakthroughs. It requires a mindset focused on win-win outcomes and mutual learning. For students and young professionals, this global shift highlights the importance of STEM education, cross-cultural understanding, and adaptability. The future belongs to those who can not only master new technologies but also cooperate across borders to solve shared challenges, from climate change to public health. This is the real essence of growth in the 21st century.
reading.translation: 世界正见证着人工智能、机器人和创新医学的飞速进步。特别是中国，其“新三大”产业取得了显著进展，出口的不仅是产品，还有专利和算法。这一演变正在重塑其全球形象。正如图灵奖得主约瑟夫·西菲斯所指出的，习近平主席即将对美国进行的国事访问，为启动造福人类的全球人工智能合作提供了绝佳机会。然而，真正的进步不仅依赖于技术突破。它还需要一种关注双赢结果和相互学习的思维方式。对于学生和年轻专业人士来说，这种全球转变凸显了STEM教育、跨文化理解以及适应能力的重要性。未来属于那些不仅能掌握新技术，还能跨境合作解决共同挑战（从气候变化到公共卫生）的人。这才是21世纪成长的真正精髓。
reading.sourceNote: 本文章基于China Daily关于中美AI合作、中国'新三大'产业及国事访问等新闻素材综合改写。
